description: This PHP class file defines the CsvDataImportService within the OrangeHRM project. It provides functionality to import and process CSV data files for employee information, including parsing CSV content into an array and handling the import process with error logging and validation.

classes.name: CsvDataImportService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to import CSV data into the system, including parsing CSV content and managing the import process, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main method to handle CSV data import. It parses CSV content, validates headers, calls the import factory, and records success and failure counts.

methods.name: getEmployeeArrayFromCSV
methods.description: Helper method to convert CSV string into a multidimensional array, validating each row for correct column count and sanitizing control characters.
